name: D03_3_target_limits_power_two_or_less_another_creature
notes: Printed: '{T}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.' Power 3 is more than 2: the activation targeting my 3/3 is refused. 'Another': the Smuggler itself (a 2/2) cannot be the target. A noncreature permanent (an artifact) is not a creature: refused. Each refusal pays nothing (the Smuggler stays untapped); the same activation at my 2/2 Bear is legal and taps the Smuggler.
